context: Naoko videocalls with a far-away cousin; first time using video.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Hina — can you see me okay?
lines.style: Relieved exhale once the connection catches. Warm but uncertain — testing the line. Kansai lilt underneath. Voice still settling into trust that this is really working.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、ちゃんと見えてる!
lines.en: Yeah! I can see you perfectly!
lines.style: Bright and immediate, no hesitation. Eight-year-old clarity and pride at being the one with the good news. Quick attack on the opening yeah, full-chested. Genuinely pleased to reassure the adult.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おう、いとこ、元気そうや!
lines.en: Oh, cousin — you look so good!
lines.style: Warmth floods in now that the connection is confirmed. Louder, more Kansai — the aunt finding her ground. Affectionate teasing edge. The words land as genuine delight, not performance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Softer now, almost wistful. Not a question despite the shape of it — a small moment of noticing how much time has passed. Eight-year-old sincerity, unguarded.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: God, I'm so happy to see you.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the opening. Tender and undefended — the aunt stops performing and just feels it. Slow, warm, a little rough with emotion. The kind of thing said once you stop worrying about how it sounds.
